severity.description: blocker = a maintainer would close or reject on this alone

id.description: contract.yml rule id, or a slug for inferred rules

source.description: file path and line range the rule comes from, or 'inferred'

quote.description: verbatim sentence from the source document

where.description: file:line, PR number, or command run

suggested_fix.description: the smallest change that clears this finding

confidence.description: calibrated, not decorative. Predicting human taste should not score 0.95.
